# ibee_cdn_purge (Action)

Explicitly purge CDN cache. Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Invoke manually or through an explicit action trigger; ordinary refresh never purges. This action does not delete origin objects.

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `distribution_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `hostnames` | `list(string)` | Optional |  |
| `mode` | `string` | Required | url, hostname, tag, prefix, or all. Some modes require service entitlements. |
| `paths` | `list(string)` | Optional |  |
| `prefixes` | `list(string)` | Optional |  |
| `tags` | `list(string)` | Optional |  |

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Configure this action in an `action` block with a nested `config` block. Invoke explicitly with `terraform apply -invoke=action.ibee_cdn_purge.example`. Actions perform operations without storing a managed resource.
